title: Compass and Landfall
author: Lior Reyes
blurb: Mirabel Sterling, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, has spent twenty years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
